body:
Here’s the perfect theme song for my upcoming book Why Did Jesus, Moses, the Buddha, and Mohammed Cross the Road? (Christian Identity in a Multi-Faith World).

Phil Madeira’s production is amazing, and Shawn Mullins’ voice is perfect. From a new collection called Hymns for the Rest of Us (More info available here: http://www.christianitytoday.com/ct/music/reviews/2012/mercyland.html) The whole CD is a delight. (Thanks for the rec, Bob Carlton!)
